subject.title: [PRUEBA BL] BL dominio marketplace: extracción por bloques

question: Should this marketplace BL tracker continue as the canonical mother issue, and who owns/reviews the remaining marketplace blocks?
rationale: The BL skill defines the workflow, but the tracker still lacks completed marketplace specs and a maintainer-owned block sequence; automation should not choose domain ownership or close the umbrella itself.

options.title: Continue this tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open, add the owner/reviewer and confirmed block order, and let each marketplace block land through focused Part-of PRs.

options.title: Replace with a newer tracker
options.body: Create or designate a newer canonical marketplace BL tracker, then close this one only after linking the replacement and preserving its checklist context.

options.title: Stop the marketplace BL track
options.body: Close the hackathon tracker intentionally and require any future marketplace BL work to be proposed as standalone scoped issues.

recommendation.title: Continue this tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, add the owner/reviewer and confirmed block order, and let each marketplace block land through focused Part-of PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the BL workflow skill and posted the current triage question about how this tracker should be structured.
